sloka: दुःखितो हि भवान् लोकान् तेजसा यदि धक्ष्यते ।आर्ताः प्रजा नर व्याघ्र क्व नु यास्यन्ति निर्वृतिम् ॥३-६६-७॥
transliteration: duḥkhito hi bhavān lokān tejasā yadi dhakṣyate ।ārtāḥ prajā nara vyāghra kva nu yāsyanti nirvṛtim ॥3-66-7॥

translations.english: It is the go of the world. Yayati, son of Nahusa, shared heaven with Indra but because of his curse (for his bad conduct) suffered misfortune.
